001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhost;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBGoTo;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBStayInPlace;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GBStormArea;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
014
015public class StormcallerGhost extends BaseSensorGhost {
016
017        public StormcallerGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
018                super(manager, 40);
019                
020                float size = genFloat(600f, 700f);
021                initEntity(genHugeSensorProfile(), size);
022                //setDespawnRange(-size * 0.7f);
023                setDespawnRange(-500f);
024                entity.addTag(Tags.UNAFFECTED_BY_SLIPSTREAM);
025                if (!placeNearPlayer()) {
026                        setCreationFailed();
027                        return;
028                }
029                
030                int numStops = 2 + manager.getRandom().nextInt(4);
031                
032                int maxBurn = 10;
033                Vector2f curr = entity.getLocation();
034                for (int i = 0; i < numStops; i++) {
035                        Vector2f loc = BaseSensorGhostCreator.findDeepHyperspaceArea(curr, 1000f, 3000f, 1000f, manager.getRandom());
036                        curr = loc;
037                        if (loc == null) {
038                                setCreationFailed();
039                                return;
040                        }
041                        SectorEntityToken target = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(loc);
042                        addBehavior(new GBGoTo(20f, target, maxBurn));
043                        addBehavior(new GBStayInPlace(0.4f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 0.3f));
044                        addBehavior(new GBStormArea(1500f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 500f));
045                        addBehavior(new GBStayInPlace(0.4f + manager.getRandom().nextFloat() * 0.3f));
046                }
047        }
048        
049}
